summary: Comprehensive frontend + backend integration test. Backend was already verified end-to-end by /app/scripts/smoke.py (all endpoints + 15 reports OK). Frontend UI flows were exercised via Playwright against the public preview URL. Nearly all critical flows pass: login (right/wrong), dashboard stat click-through to Finance, Vehicles page loading, Settings add locations + routes (with save), indoor trip create, driver/vehicle conflict error, outdoor trip with temporary vehicle (does NOT create a permanent vehicle unless the checkbox is set), LR creation from trip with new sender auto-saving to Parties + autocomplete suggest, Party ledger record-payment (12,000 -> 11,000), Deewanji handover recording, Finance expense/fuel(Credit)/payables listing HP Hinganghat, 3PL trip add, driver advance, Reports page loads 16 report chips, global search finds vehicle/party/trip/LR, and mobile viewport quick-action sheet with quick-collection opens the entry modal.

minor.issue: Cash-in-hand and Bank balance can go negative (Cash ₹-4,050, Bank ₹-3,900 seen after normal expense/payment entries) because the cashbook uses 0 as opening balance. Consider allowing an opening balance in Settings or clamping display.

ui_bugs.issue: When submitting the Add Vehicle modal without a vehicle_no we get a 400 from POST /api/masters/vehicles. Field-level validation should be shown before submit; also the modal input for the vehicle number does not carry a discoverable data-testid (e.g. mf-vehicle_no), which hurts automated testing and consistency with the rest of the app (LR/Trip forms use explicit test ids).
Report tiles use data-testid="report-{name}" (found 16). The system-prompt-style selector [data-testid^="report-chip-"] does not exist. Cosmetic — but worth noting for other testers.

issues: Cash-in-hand and Bank Balance displayed as negative amounts in the same tone as positives. A red/muted style for negative balances would communicate the position better.

action_items: Add field-level validation + explicit data-testid attributes to the vehicle master form fields (mf-vehicle_no, etc.) so the Add Vehicle modal is testable in an automated way.
Consider allowing an opening balance in Settings for cash/bank so newly-installed dashboards don't show negative balances after the first expense.
(Nit) Consider aligning report tile testids with the pattern report-chip-{name} if that convention was intended in the spec; otherwise document the actual convention (report-{name}).
Reduce React-Router future-flag warnings by enabling the recommended future flags — cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py + ledger.py look clean; balances are derived and cancel endpoints reverse ledger entries (verified via UI: 12,000 outstanding -> 11,000 after 1,000 receipt).
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly; no hardcoded URLs seen.
Autocomplete testid is placed directly on the <input> (data-testid="lr-sender"), not on a wrapper — good and consistent.
MasterForm modal fields do not have per-field data-testids while other pages (LRForm, TripForm, QuickForms) do — inconsistency worth fixing for testability.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (12/13 major flows pass; only add-vehicle full-round-trip failed due to modal field discovery)

seed_data_creation: Created a couple of TESTSENDER<ts> parties via LR, one TestCust3PL 3PL trip, a driver advance of ₹1,000, a ₹250 expense, a ₹1,900 fuel-Credit entry, and two extra base locations + one route in Settings. Also 2 extra trips (indoor TRP1002 & outdoor TRP1003 with a temp vehicle). No production/seed data was deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/scripts/smoke.py — re-run only if backend changes. UI covered with Playwright; the trickiest gotcha is that many components put data-testid on the actual <input>, not on a wrapper, so use selectors like [data-testid="lr-sender"] directly (not [data-testid="lr-sender"] input). The Vehicles master modal is the exception — its inputs do not expose testids yet.
rca of the issue: Add-vehicle test failure RCA: MasterForm renders the vehicle_no input without a data-testid, so the Playwright script could only rely on placeholder/name attributes which weren't unique inside a 18-input modal. The submit therefore posted an empty vehicle_no and the backend correctly rejected it (400). Fix by main agent: add data-testid="mf-<fieldname>" (or similar) to inputs in /app/frontend/src/components/MasterForm.jsx. This is a testability gap, not a runtime bug.
